description: Maryland Port Administration General Cargo is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. Maryland Port Administration General Cargo Monthly Data for the MPA's public terminals (Souce: Internal MPA data). Coverage: Maryland. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are port of baltimore, auto, container, general cargo, maryland port administration. The table has 21 columns. Attribution on the portal: MDOT Maryland Port Administration. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
